title: Working Student (m/f/d) - Project Management Asset Services
description:
**Hybrid | Part time | Student (not yet graduated)**
Trench Group is a global technology leader for high-voltage grid components and systems, present in nearly every power transmission grid worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, with more than 100 years of engineering expertise, Trench Group designs and manufactures high-voltage components that address the core challenges of modern power infrastructure – connecting grids, measuring their performance and ensuring reliability. As electricity demand rises and power grids transform worldwide, Trench Group is a key enabler of the infrastructure the world needs. The company operates 11 factories across 8 countries on 4 continents and employs more than 3,000 people – with plans to grow to 4,000 by 2030.
  
  
**Your Misson**
As a Working Student in Asset Services, you will support global product development, customer support process optimization, project coordination, and AI-driven reporting initiatives. You will collaborate with international teams across Sales, After Sales, IT, business units, external vendors, and manufacturing sites to develop effective service solutions and improve operational efficiency.
  
  
**Your Tasks:**

* Product Support: Support for Asset Services on installed base and Reporting at a global level across factories.
* Processes: Work with EMEA and Americas teams to develop, improve, and streamline customer support processes.
* Partnerships: Support the development of partnerships with external vendors and assist in creating required offers and documentation.
* Project Management: Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders on project activities, track progress, follow up on action items, and support reporting.
* Technical Development: Support the development of AI-based tools for internal reporting and business applications.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with Sales, After Sales, local business units, IT, and global factories to develop and implement joint solutions.

**Requirements:**

* Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in a Business, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical field.
* Ideally gained practical experience through an internship, working student position, or project in an international environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Strong teamwork, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies, especially AI-based tools, agentic coding, and development environments.
* Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented mindset.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

**We offer:**

* Growth with Purpose: Join a globally growing energy company with a vision and a bright future in the energy transition
* Strong Teams, Big Energy: Work in highly professional, international teams defined by respect, appreciation, and a shared drive to shape the future of energy
* Fair Rewards: Competitive pay, monthly vouchers for shopping, well‑being, or personal development, plus subsidized lunch and membership in a corporate benefits program
* Personal & Professional Development: Learn and grow in an international environment with hands‑on experience and continuous development opportunities
* Modern Working Environment: A modern way of working, 30 days’ vacation, and a tariff agreement combined with contemporary offices, height‑adjustable desks, free fruit & coffee, and regular team events

HAVE WE PIQUED YOUR INTEREST? We are looking forward to receiving your application - just click on the "Apply Now" button and send us your application.

title: Working Student Product Operations (m/f/d)
description:
**Allow us to introduce ourselves**

Hello there! We're Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we're now humbled to call the world our playground, with over **260 employees** spread across **13 countries** (we're remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from **+190 markets,** globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement?

Here at Appinio, we value **transparency** **in our recruitment process**, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together:**here**

**Your mission as a Working Student - Product Operations**

We are looking for a **Working Student - Product Operations (m/f/d)** to support the daily operations of the Appinio mobile app and help ensure a smooth, high-quality user experience.

Working closely with our Product Management team, you will help identify and resolve user issues, monitor app quality, and support community operations. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in Product Operations while contributing to a mobile product used by a global community.

**What you will be doing**

* **User Support & Issue Management:** Review and manage incoming support tickets from the Appinio app help center. Understand, categorize, and prioritize user-reported issues, validate them by reproducing bugs, and check whether they are genuine, urgent, or already known. Escalate to Product Managers when needed.
* **App Quality Monitoring:** Perform daily quality checks of the mobile app to ensure key user flows are working properly.
* **Community Operations:** Perform manual checks related to community operations, including user bans and related review tasks, based on internal guidelines.
* **Insights & Prioritization Input:** Identify patterns in support requests and monitor recurring user pain points. Highlight them to Product Managers so they feed into product prioritization.
* **Documentation & Collaboration:** Document findings clearly and maintain internal tracking of bugs, incidents, and quality issues. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Development and Quality Assurance.

**You will thrive in this role if**

* You are currently enrolled at a university and have **at least 1 year of studies remaining.**
* You have a strong interest in mobile apps, product management, product operations, and user experience, along with a good understanding of mobile applications and common user issues.
* You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to work through tasks in a structured way. You are comfortable handling operational tasks, recurring processes, and repetitive work while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* You have strong communication skills and can clearly describe issues and observations.
* You are proactive, reliable, and have a high sense of ownership. You can identify what is important and urgent and are comfortable making judgment calls within clear guidelines.
* You have ideally gained some initial experience in customer support, manual app testing and bug reproduction, mobile app operations, quality assurance, or product-related work.
* You have ideally worked with spreadsheets or reporting tools to track operational work and issues.
* You are based in Germany

**What's in it for you?**

* Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location.

**Kind reminder:** Please ensure that your application is submitted in English.

*This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm.*

*Appinio is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.*  
  
**Please read our privacy policy** **here****.**

**Learn more about us:**

title: Working Student Spare Parts & Training Plan (m/w/d)
description:
**Job Description Summary**
**Job Description**
For Grid Solutions, Offshore HVDC represents a key differentiating technology and a central focus for the business, particularly in Europe where Transmission System Operators have ambitious renewable energy targets. We are looking for a Working Student to support the Spare Parts and Customer Training workstreams for a portfolio of mega HVDC projects based in Berlin, Germany.
  
  

* Your Responsibilities:

+ Project Operations: Support the Project Management team in executing operational milestones and tracking project progress.
+ RAMS & Technical Alignment: Coordinate with internal RAMS and engineering teams to ensure project documentation is accurate and technically aligned with specifications.
+ Spare Parts Strategy: Support the "wing-to-wing" management of the spare parts strategy, including compiling documentation, maintaining the Spare Parts List (SPL), and tracking procurement statuses.
+ Training Management: Support the development of the Training Management Plan and take ownership of maintaining the Training Matrix to ensure all customer contractual requirements are met.
+ Documentation & Reporting: Supplement and revise project presentations and technical documents; maintain and analyze complex data in MS Excel, Smartsheet, SAP, and MS Project.
+ Stakeholder Engagement: Participate in meetings with customers and internal departments, ensuring clear communication and timely follow-up on action items.

* Your Profile:

+ Education: Currently pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field.
+ Technical Proficiency: A "Digital native" proficient in MS Office. Advanced MS Excel skills (including PivotTables) are essential. Experience with Smartsheet, Power BI, or SAP is a significant advantage.
+ Working Style: Independent, reliable, and structured, with a hands-on mentality and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
+ Collaboration: A natural team player who thrives in virtual, international environments.
+ Communication: Strong communication skills with a customer-oriented mindset.
+ Languages: English is mandatory; German language skills are a significant advantage.

* We Offer:

+ Smooth Onboarding: Welcome days to ensure a successful start.
+ Flexibility: Flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely.
+ Mentorship: Work directly alongside experienced Project Managers and technical specialists.
+ Career Growth: Exposure to the full lifecycle of major offshore wind grid connection projects.
+ Culture: Experience a fast-paced environment with access to the Berlin site’s company cafeteria and other corporate benefits.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
No

title: Working Student E-Commerce (f/m/d)
description:
Do you want to experience e-commerce not just in theory, but directly in day-to-day operations? As a Working Student in the E-commerce team, you will support us operationally with product launches, catalog management, and digital marketing campaigns. You will take on responsibility early on, work closely with the rest of the marketing team, and learn how modern e-commerce works in a fast-paced start-up environment.

**Your Tasks**
==============

* **Online Product Launches:** Supporting our online product launches, tracking timelines, and ensuring product information is accurate and up to date.
* **Catalog & Assortment Management:** Managing our product assortment and catalog, overseeing product categorization, avoiding SKU duplication, and maintaining a clean, logical assortment structure.
* **Campaign Organization in Notion:** Managing and organizing online campaign projects in Notion, ensuring tasks, timelines, and documentation are structured and up to date.
* **E-Commerce Projects & Website Maintenance:** Supporting e-commerce projects, tests, and ongoing website maintenance initiatives.
* **KPI Monitoring & Reporting:** Assisting with KPI monitoring, reporting, and website analysis to help identify growth opportunities.

**Your Profile**
================

* **Studies & Motivation:** Enrolled student with curiosity, motivation, and a genuine interest in start-ups, e-commerce, and digital marketing.
* **Project Management:** Strong project management skills with enthusiasm for organizing projects and working with digital tools.
* **Analytical Skills:** Proficient in Google Sheets and MS Excel.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Experience with Notion; previous hands-on experience with Shopware or Hygraph is a strong plus.
* **Work Style:** Strong communication skills, excellent organization, and a results-driven mindset.
* **Languages:** Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

**What you can expect from us**
===============================

* **Smart Working & Flexibility:** Hybrid work and flexible hours that fit perfectly around your lecture schedule or exam periods. No making coffee or endless photocopying here – we trust you with real ownership from day one.
* **Growth & Onboarding:** You are a fully integrated team member! With your ideas, you can actively shape the future of the food retail industry in a fast-growing scale-up. You’ll receive a structured onboarding and your own MacBook for your time with us.
* **KoRo Life & Extras:** Find your way (back) to the gym thanks to our fitness partnerships like Urban Sports Club or FitX. You’ll also get a 20% discount in our KoRo online store and exclusive perks with partner companies. Plus, free snacks and barista coffee are always waiting for you at the office!
* **Shared Moments:** Regular team events and company parties to celebrate our milestones and successes together.

**We're looking for People who share our Mindset**
==================================================

For us, it's not just about the *what*, but above all about the *how*. You'll be a perfect fit for us if you have the following mindset:

* **You take initiative and ownership.** You don't wait for a perfect brief or a mandate to get started. When you see an opportunity, a risk, or something that can be improved - you act. When things don't go as planned, you look at your own contribution first and step up, without waiting to be asked.
* **You thrive in change.** Shifting priorities and evolving processes don't slow you down. You adapt fast and keep moving.
* **You build, you don't wait.** When something is missing - a tool, a process, a solution - you create it. You prefer a working MVP over a perfect plan and iterate from there.
* **You think in leverage.** You question how things are done, prioritize ruthlessly, and find smarter paths to better outcomes. You don't mistake effort for impact.
* **You're a team player, humble and genuinely kind.** You collaborate in and across teams, care about the people around you, and bring sparkles to the room. You speak up when you disagree, commit fully once a decision is made, and actively make the people around you better.

***Own it – Move fast – Build it – Create impact – Lift others***

**Sounds good?**
================

Then we’d love to hear from you! Send us your **CV** and tell us a little about yourself in a few introductory sentences – who you are, what drives you, and why you’d like to become part of KoRo. After all, we’re looking for team members, not just co-workers!

**The KoRo team is just as diverse as our product range!** We want to keep it that way as our nut-loving team grows. That’s why we welcome all applicants regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity.

Ready to join KoRo? **We look forward to hearing from you!**

title: Working Student - Project management and Construction (all genders)
description:
Q ENERGY is Europe’s 360° green energy company. Together with our more than 500 employees we develop, build, and manage renewable energy assets across the entire value chain of large-scale renewable energy projects – from solar, to onshore wind and offshore wind, to energy storage and hybrid power plants. With a pipeline of more than 11 GW we are among the leading renewable energy companies in Europe. We are always on the lookout for people who want to work with us to empower a sustainable world with green energy.

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Working Student** to support the successful delivery of utility-scale renewable energy projects from development through construction and into operational handover.

Working closely with experienced Project Managers, you will gain broad exposure to the entire project lifecycle, supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and commercial management of complex solar PV, battery storage, wind, and other renewable energy infrastructure projects. This role is an excellent opportunity for engineering students who are passionate about the energy transition and aspire to build a career in project management within the renewable energy sector.

Your responsibilities:

You will join our project management team and support the delivery of EPC construction projects. The role is broad. You won’t be expected to cover everything below. Your tasks will depend on your background, interests, and experience, and you’ll grow into more areas over time.

Depending on your focus, you may support us with:

Planning and project controls:

* Developing and implementing project execution plans, schedules, budgets, quality plans, reporting structures, and risk management plans
* Tracking project progress against key milestones and KPIs, identifying risks, issues, delays, and cost impacts, and helping implement mitigation measures
* Monitoring project costs, forecasts, cash flow, invoice verification, and budget performance
* The invoice payment process and internal approvals

Contracts and commercial management

* Administering the main EPC contract with clients and monitoring compliance with contractual obligations, rights, and responsibilities
* Ensuring contractual requirements are reflected in procurement activities, subcontract agreements, project strategies, and execution plans
* Managing contractual claims, variation orders, and commercial negotiations with clients and subcontractors
* Technical evaluations and the selection of EPC subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and specialized service providers

Delivery and coordination

* Coordinating engineering, procurement, quality assurance, permitting, construction, commissioning, and handover activities
* Ensuring permitting requirements, grid connection requirements, environmental obligations, and technical specifications are incorporated into project planning and execution
* Managing technical interfaces between contractors, suppliers, utilities, clients, and other project stakeholders
* Coordinating project activities to ensure timely delivery and a smooth transition into Operations & Maintenance (O&M)

  
**Requirements**  

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in one of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Energy Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Advanced German (at least B2) and good command of English
* Good knowledge of MS Office (especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
* Genuine interest in renewable energy and project management
* Structured, detail-oriented, and proactive way of working

  
**Benefits**

We value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* **Our workplace:** Located in a modern and sustainable office building just a few steps from Südkreuz station, making it easily accessible for all employees.
* **IT Equipment:** We’ll set you up with a laptop, monitor, headphones, and, if needed, a company phone.
* **Work-Life Balance:** we value your personal time. Enjoy the flexibility to choose your work hours, so you can prioritize what matters most—whether it’s attending a workout class, handling personal matters, or starting your weekend a little earlier. You’re in control.
* **Mobile Working:** At Q ENERGY we offer a hybrid work model: three days in the office and two days of mobile working. This setup supports in-person teamwork while also allowing for more flexibility and reduced commuting.
* **Spendit Card:** €25 monthly allowance on top of your monthly salary, which can be used for your daily lunch or can be saved up unlimitedly.
* **Public Transport Allowance:** Enjoy a €15 monthly contribution to your BVG ticket—making your commute easier and more affordable!
* **Generous Vacation Policy:** Enjoy a well-deserved break and take 30 vacation days a year plus two special leave days, giving you 32 days total to relax, recharge, and explore!
* **Onboarding:** We provide a detailed onboarding process to ensure you have a smooth and successful start with us, helping you feel supported and prepared from day one.
* **Insurance Coverage:** With accident and life insurance included, we’ve got you covered, giving you peace of mind on and off the job.
* **Corporate Discounts:** Employees get access to exclusive offers and discounts for various brands through our Corporate Benefits program.
* **Corporate Health Management:** Prioritize your well-being with our corporate health management program, including preventive check-ups to keep you at your best!
* **Mutual support:** You’ll thrive in a supportive environment where open communication, teamwork, and knowledge sharing are highly valued. We’re committed to your growth, encouraging your professional and personal development through ongoing support and guidance.

Then we look forward to receiving your application. Please let us know your salary expectations and your earliest possible starting date.

Please note: We do not accept applications by email. Please use the "Apply for this Job" button for your application. Thank you very much!  
  
If you have any questions, please contact our Recruiting team recruiting@qenergy.eu.

title: Working Student (f/m/d) Project Management Excellence
description:
**If you really want to make a difference – make it with us**

**Siemens Mobility** is a separately managed company of Siemens AG and has been a leading supplier in the field of mobility for over 160 years. Our core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems and related services. We have always been very innovative in making traveling faster, safer and more comfortable. Today, we need new solutions to new challenges such as climate change and rising populations worldwide. That's what drives us. That's why we shape mobility with passion, always being one step ahead. Through digitalization, we make infrastructures smart and create opportunities that get us from A to B sustainably and seamlessly. Our over 40,000 employees are pioneers in mobility who help to keep the world moving.

  

**What do you contribute?**

In this role, you combine project management, digitalization and Artificial Intelligence. You bring your own ideas and help us develop innovative solutions, identify new opportunities to simplify processes, leverage knowledge and continuously improve the way we manage projects.

* You support Project Management Excellence initiatives, collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders from different countries, functions and businesses.
* Furthermore, you contribute to optimizing project management processes, methods, tools and standards while identifying opportunities for improvement.
* You explore innovative applications of Artificial Intelligence in project management and support the development, testing and implementation of AI-powered solutions, agents and dashboards.
* Additionally, you help automate recurring tasks, improve access to knowledge and promote data-driven decision-making in project management.
* You support the preparation of workshops, project reviews, assessments, and training sessions and support their organizational and content-related execution.
* Moreover, you support the development of training concepts and knowledge-sharing resources for our international Project Management community and promote the exchange of best practices.
* You coordinate cross-country initiatives, follow up on agreed action items, and contribute your own ideas to ensure sustainable improvements.

  

**What do you bring along?**

* You are currently studying Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Engineering, Project Management, Business Informatics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or a comparable field.
* You are passionate about project management and Project Management Excellence and ideally have gained initial practical experience in project management, a PMO or a project-oriented environment.
* Furthermore, you are enthusiastic about Artificial Intelligence and digitalization and have gained initial hands-on experience with generative AI applications such as Microsoft Copilot.
* Ideally, you have basic knowledge of Power BI and other digitalization tools and enjoy helping us put innovative solutions into practice.
* Additionally, you are confident in using Microsoft 365, particularly PowerPoint and Excel, and can present complex information in a clear and compelling way.
* Moreover, you communicate confidently with different stakeholders, enjoy working in international teams and have very good English skills as well as basic German language skills.

  

**What do we offer you?**

Inclusion & Diversity

At Siemens Mobility, we're committed to fighting injustice and inequality. At our company, you will find an environment where you can be yourself and belong.

Purpose

We are pioneers in mobility. At Siemens Mobility, you will actively contribute to the transformation of transportation and climate protection in a market of the future, because our transportation solutions reduce CO2 emissions all over the world.

Mobile working /Remote working

With us, you will have the opportunity to work hybrid. This means that you can work remotely to a considerable extent. We have officially regulated this through a company agreement.

Attractive conditions

With us you will receive an attractive salary. You start with about 15€ per hour and from the 7th month on about 19€.

You can find an overview of our benefits here.

if you would like to clarify further questions about the position via our applicant hotline.

if you would like more information about jobs and careers at Siemens.

**Short description**
---------------------

RLI is a non-profit research institute in Berlin. In the project CC-IDI (Oct 2026 Sep 2029), funded by the International Climate Initiative (IKI), we support island communities on Romblon, Sibuyan and Corcuera (Philippines) in planning their climate-neutral energy supply, together with our Philippine partners. You support the project team in Berlin with project management, documentation, communication and data analysis.

**Your tasks**
--------------

* Research and preparation of information on the project islands (local climate action plans, power supply, stakeholders)
* Support in project management: to-do lists, scheduling, meeting minutes, coordination with the Philippine partners
* Support in project documentation and reporting, including filing of receipts
* Preparation of workshops, travel and stakeholder meetings
* Communication support: presentations, website content, newsletter, social media
* Data evaluation and overviews (electricity demand, costs, participation processes)

**Your profile**
----------------

* Candidates must be enrolled at a university, preferably in energy or environmental sciences, geography, economics, politics, development cooperation or a related relevant field
* Residence and right of abode in Germany is required
* Very good English language skills are required (C1), good German language skills
* Confident use of Office applications and spreadsheets
* Interest in the energy transition, climate action and working with local communities
* Knowledge of the Philippines, international project experience or Tagalog is a plus
* Experience with project tools, graphics or presentations is a plus
* Identification with the RLI Values
* We require an independent, systematic, and meticulous approach to work, as well as the ability to communicate and document work results

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Friendly and open working atmosphere in a young, interdisciplinary team (around 85 people currently work at RLI, including around 25 students)
* A transparent and participative corporate culture
* Location on the Adlershof science campus with excellent public transport connections
* Possibility of mobile working / flexible working hours without core hours and flexible working locations within Germany by arrangement
* Vacation days according to statutory vacation entitlement
* RLI Christmas party / end-of-year party - a highlight for all employees
* Internal training opportunities and professional support / further development
* Regular RLI days at Tempelhofer Feld or other locations with a wide range of workshops
* Participation in the Adlershof health network - free impulses as part of company health management

---------------------

* Start of work on 01.01.2027 or by arrangement
* Between 40 and 60 hours per month possible by arrangement
* Remuneration with a gross hourly rate of €15.50 per hour

, and have raised
**€18M in funding**
(last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.
  
  
We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.
  
  
In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.
  
  
We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.
  
  
Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.
  
  
*As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area.*
Who We Want
  
  
**Hungry learner**
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.
  
  
**Structured self-starter**
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.
  
  
**Analytical thinker**
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.
  
  
**Customer-curious**
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.
  
  
**Clear communicator**
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.
  
  
**Scrappy generalist**
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".
  
  
**AI-native**
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.
  
  
**Has taste**
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".
  
  
**Language**
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.
  
  
Who We Don't Want
  
  

* You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks
* You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive
* You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience
* You get defensive when receiving feedback
* You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on

**Your Day to Day**
Strategic Projects (~25%)
  
  

* Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now
* Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results

Product Marketing & Launches (~35%)
  
  

* Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content
* Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marketing
* Build sharp slides and reports for customers and leadership

Customer Research (~20%)
  
  

* Run customer interviews and turn what you hear into clear insights for the product team
* Feed those insights into roadmap decisions together with our PMs

Product Analytics & Adoption (~20%)
  
  

* Own dashboards on activation and adoption and turn the numbers into actions
* Drive initiatives that improve activation and adoption of key features

**Stakeholders**
**Product Managers:**
Feed customer insights and data into roadmap decisions and support with research, specs and launch prep
  
  
**Engineering & Design:**
Clarify requirements, gather product feedback and coordinate release timing for launches
  
  
**Customer Success:**
Identify customers for interviews and work together on onboarding, activation and adoption initiatives
  
  
**Sales:**
Build enablement material and slides, and align on positioning and messaging for new features
  
  
**Marketing:**
Co-own product launches, webinars, release content and campaigns
  
  
**Customers:**
Run interviews and webinars, collect feedback and turn it into insights for the team
  
  
Why People Choose Us
  
  

* We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
* We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
* We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
* We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
* We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

**Benefits & Culture**

* Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.
* Regular company-wide and team events.
* An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.
* An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.
* A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

**We want to build a community, not just a company.**
Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.
  
  
**We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you!**
**By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy.**
**We look forward to receiving your application! 🙂**

title: People & Culture - Working Student (all genders)
description:
**About us**
------------

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

**Your Role**
-------------

Do you want to drive turn everyday People administration into a seamless, high-quality experience for every single employee?

Are you ready to support both the operational engine and the talent growth of a fast-paced tech scale-up?

If you are a detail-oriented student who loves supporting people and keeping processes sharp by bringing employees and business needs together, **then you are our perfect match!**

Expect a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side. You will gain deep in-depth knowledge of the entire employee life cycle, from initial recruitment to the final stage of a successful career.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Support People Admin:** You help our People Operations with everyday employee inquiries, such as holidays, workations and learning budgets, and you keep our Jira Service Management tickets moving with speed and care.
* **Help Keep Data Accurate:** You support the maintenance of employee master data and digital personal files, following clear guidelines, so that everything stays accurate and up to date.
* **Document Support:** You prepare employment certificates, reference letters and other essential HR documents in German and English.
* **Talent Spotlight:** You help us look after the perfect candidate, from the first review of applications for junior roles to taking notes in interviews, so that the experience stays world-class.
* **Process Coordination:** You help the recruiting process run smoothly by scheduling interviews and following up with stakeholders to keep the momentum high.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

**Experience**

* You are currently enrolled and studying Business Administration, Human Resources Management, Psychology, or a related subject.
* Initial experience in fast-paced companies or HR environment is a plus.
* Experience in a Tech Scale-up environment is a bonus.

**Skills**

* **Bilingual Proficiency:** You speak and write German and English at a professional level (C1/Native).
* **Organizational Talent:** You can juggle multiple tasks and projects without losing your cool or your attention to detail.
* **Tech Savvy:** You are comfortable (or eager to learn) working with tools like Personio, Leapsome, Jira, and Google Workspace.

**Mindset**

* **Detail Lover:** Accuracy is your quiet superpower.
* **Discreet & Trustworthy:** You handle sensitive data with care.
* **Eager Learner:** You see feedback as fuel.
* **You enjoy both working as part of the People Team and collaborating with it:** You come to our Berlin-Mitte office at least twice a week to work alongside us.

**Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto**
------------------------------------

* **Best of Both Worlds:** We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.
* **Work from (Almost) Anywhere:** We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.
* **Recharge & Unwind:** We value your downtime. You start with 26 days of leave, plus we love to top that up with additional discretionary "X-days" to make sure you’re truly rested.
* **Multicultural & Inclusive Team:** We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.
* **Fuel Your Growth:** We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.
* **Exclusive Employee Discounts:** Get more for your money with access to the "Benefits at Work" platform, offering significant discounts on top global brands.
* **Your Benefits, Your Choice:** Through Probonio, you get a monthly budget to spend on what matters to you—whether that’s your public transport pass or other flexible perks that fit your lifestyle.

**What Matters to Us**
----------------------

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team!  
  
We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

title: Werkstudent Contract, Risk, IT Asset & Vendor Management (m/w/d)
description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory – für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen – getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich **Consulting** – **Extended Enterprise** Unternehmen dabei helfen, die wachsenden Risiken in digitalen Ökosystemen und Lieferketten aktiv zu steuern und mit datengetriebenen Lösungen nachhaltig abzusichern? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns innovative Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, Risiko und Business. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden entlang des gesamten Lifecycles - von der Analyse bestehender Risiken bis zur Implementierung konkreter Steuerungs- und Technologielösungen, z. B. im Bereich AI-gestützter Risikoanalysen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als **Werkstudent Contract, Risk, IT Asset & Vendor Management (m/w/d).**

Standorte: **Stuttgart****, Berlin****, Düsseldorf****, Frankfurt (Main)****, Hamburg****, Köln****, Leipzig** **und München**.

**Dein Impact:**
----------------

Als Werkstudent Contract, Risk, IT Asset & Vendor Management (m/w/d) unterstützt du unsere Teams dabei, das Zusammenspiel von Geschäftspartnern, Verträgen, Technologie und Daten zu verbessern. Je nach Interesse und Projektbedarf bringst du dich in unterschiedliche Themen ein und entwickelst dein eigenes fachliches Profil.

* **Tagesgeschäft:** Du gewinnst Einblicke in Software Vendor Consulting, IT Asset Management, FinOps & AI Tokenomics, Third Party Risk Management sowie Contract Lifecycle Management. Gemeinsam mit unseren Expert:innen unterstützt du Kunden dabei, Kosten zu optimieren, Risiken zu reduzieren und Geschäftsbeziehungen wirksam zu steuern.
* **Artificial Intelligence (AI):** Du wirkst an praxisnahen AI-Anwendungsfällen mit, zum Beispiel an der Auswertung von Verträgen, der Analyse von Geschäftspartner- und Nutzungsdaten oder der Automatisierung von Recherche und Reporting. Dabei lernst du, AI-Tools verantwortungsvoll einzusetzen und Ergebnisse auf Qualität und Nachvollziehbarkeit zu prüfen.
* **Projektarbeit & Zusammenarbeit:** Du bereitest Analysen, Präsentationen und Angebotsunterlagen auf, unterstützt Workshops und das Projektmanagement und arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen verschiedener Capability Groups zusammen. Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du eigene Aufgabenpakete.
* **Digitale Transformation:** Du unterstützt bei der Analyse und Optimierung von Prozessen und Assetmanagementsystemen sowie bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen für Einkauf, Vertrags-, und Risikomanagement.
* **Analyse & Insights:** Du recherchierst und analysierst Daten zu Geschäftspartnern, Verträgen, Software, Cloud-Nutzung und Kosten. Dabei hilfst du, Transparenz zu schaffen, Auffälligkeiten zu erkennen und Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten.

**Dein Skillset:**
------------------

* **Fortgeschrittenes Studium** der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwissenschaften, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit guten Leistungen
* **Interesse an digitaler Transformation** sowie am Zusammenspiel von Business, Technologie und Risiko. Erste praktische Erfahrungen, beispielsweise durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder Hochschulprojekte in den Bereichen Beratung, Datenanalyse, Einkauf, Vertrags- oder Risikomanagement, sind von Vorteil
* **Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office**, insbesondere in Excel und PowerPoint, sowie Interesse an datengetriebenen Fragestellungen. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Artificial Intelligence oder AI-gestützten Tools sind willkommen
* **Strukturierte Arbeitsweise**, analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Freude daran, komplexe Fragestellungen eigenständig und gemeinsam im Team zu bearbeiten und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln
* **Deutsch und Englisch** sehr gut in Wort und Schrift sowie Bereitschaft zu projektbezogenen Reisen

**Deine Chance:**
-----------------

* **Echte Verantwortung** für eigene Aufgabenpakete innerhalb unserer Projekte, die du selbständig bearbeitest
* **Persönliche:r Mentor:in** in deinem Team, der/die dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht und dich mit umfassendem Know-how unterstützt
* **Ein chancenreiches und internationales Umfeld**, das dir einmalige Einblicke in die Arbeit des weltweit größten Prüfungs- und Beratungsunternehmens bietet
* **Work-Life-Balance** in einem innovativen Unternehmensumfeld, das dir Gesundheitstage, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events und vieles mehr bietet
* **Bereichsübergreifendes Networking** im Deloitte Student Network mit exklusiven Vorträgen und regelmäßigem Austausch beim Praktikant:innen-Stammtisch
* **Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume** und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

**Wann du verfügbar sein solltest**
-----------------------------------

Wir suchen ab sofort Studierende für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit für mindestens 6 Monate - sehr gerne auch länger.

**Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied!**
-------------------------------------------------

Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.

**Gleiche Chancen für alle:** Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die so vielfältig sind wie wir – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft und Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. **Noch Fragen?** Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren**Bewerbungs-FAQs****.**

**Dein Kontakt bei Fragen rund um Karrierethemen**

Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111.

title: Working Student (m/w/d) - Cyber Security Engineering
description:
As a leading global software product company in Compliance & Automation, IMTF Group develops innovative RegTech solutions focusing on Anti-Money Laundering, Know Your Customer, and Anti-Fraud. Our technology helps financial institutions fight financial crime and meet demanding regulatory requirements.

At IMTF, we value innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. We encourage our teams to explore new technologies, challenge existing approaches, and continuously improve how we develop and deliver secure software.

As a Working Student in Cyber Security Engineering, you will join our Research & Development organization and help improve the security tools we develop and use internally. You will work on vulnerability scanners, security automation, and supporting software that helps us identify, assess, and address security risks across our products.

This is a hands-on software engineering role where you can apply your academic knowledge to real-world security challenges.

### **Responsibilities**

* Develop and enhance our internal security tools, including vulnerability scanners and automated security checks
* Improve vulnerability detection, analysis, and reporting to deliver accurate and actionable security findings
* Help automate security assessments of applications, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure
* Contribute to tools and processes for software supply chain security, including SBOM and vulnerability management
* Research emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security technologies and evaluate their relevance to our software
* Integrate security tools and automated checks into our development and CI/CD workflows
* Collaborate with software engineers to improve the effectiveness and reliability of our security tooling
* Explore opportunities to leverage AI and automation to make security analysis more efficient

  
**Requirements**  

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Cyber Security, IT Security, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Basic programming skills, preferably in Python, and an interest in developing real-world software
* Foundational understanding of IT security, networking, operating systems, and common software vulnerabilities
* Interest in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and DevSecOps practices
* Familiarity with Linux, Git, or container technologies is an advantage
* Curiosity about security tools, automation, and emerging technologies
* Analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills, and a hands-on approach
* Interest in using modern AI-assisted development tools
* Ability to work independently while actively collaborating with a development team
* Good communication skills in English; German language skills are an advantage

Previous professional experience in Cyber Security is not required. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn.

 **Benefits**  

* **Make the World Safer:** Help us strengthen the security of software used to combat financial crime
* **Be Part of an Established RegTech:** Gain practical experience at an international Swiss software company
* **Hands-on Engineering:** Work on real security software and contribute improvements that make a measurable difference
* **Ownership and Development:** Take responsibility for your work, learn from experienced engineers, and develop your technical skills
* **Paid Further Education:** Benefit from opportunities to expand your knowledge and professional capabilities
* **International Exposure:** Collaborate with colleagues across different countries and engineering disciplines

The anticipated salary for this Working Student - Cyber Engineering position in Germany is EUR 18,000 gross per year, based on a 20-hour working week (50% employment level).

At IMTF, we are committed to treating all candidates with respect and equality, regardless of gender, religion, nationality, or any other characteristic. We embrace diversity and inclusion as integral parts of our organizational culture and welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

title: Werkstudent Transformation Office (m/w/d)
description:
**In Deutschland**
- Berlin
  
  
Interessierst du dich für Transformation, Projektmanagement und die Möglichkeiten, die KI für die Arbeitswelt bietet? Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir Studierende, die Lust auf Praxis neben dem Studium haben und unser Transformation Office bei der Umsetzung unseres unternehmensweiten Transformationsprogramms für
**15 bis 20 Std./Woche**
unterstützen möchten.
  
  
Du bist noch für
**mindestens 12 Monate**
als Student eingeschrieben und hast Interesse daran, unser Team langfristig zu unterstützen.
  
  
**Mehr Von Uns Für Dich**

* Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: profitiere von regelmäßigem Feedback und bringe deine eigene Perspektive in unsere Unternehmenskultur ein. Zusätzlich erhältst du einen einjährigen kostenfreien Zugang zu LinkedIn Learning, den du auch nach deiner Zeit bei uns nutzen kannst.
* Gut umsorgt: mit gesunden Snacks und Getränken in unseren Offices.
* Easy durch den Uni-Alltag: durch eine marktgerechte Vergütung und Flexibilität im Rahmen der vereinbarten Arbeitstage.
* Gemeinsam feiern: vernetze dich bei regelmäßigen Mitarbeitenden-Events mit unseren Kolleg:innen.
* Gemeinsam wachsen: Nachhaltig und langfristig! Darum dreht sich alles bei Simon-Kucher. Unsere Stärke: ein mitreißendes, hoch motiviertes und sympathisches Team. Und jetzt kommst du: mitten hinein in die offene, wertschätzende Start-up-Atmosphäre eines etablierten Unternehmens mit 40-jähriger Erfolgsgeschichte.

**Hier Bewegst Du Was**

* Du wirkst im Transformation Office bei Projektmanagement- und Governance-Aktivitäten für unser unternehmensweites Transformationsprogramm mit und arbeitest dabei mit verschiedenen Projektteams und Funktionen zusammen.
* Du unterstützt das Projekt- und OKR-Reporting (Objectives and Key Results), konsolidierst Status-Updates und bereitest Präsentationen und Unterlagen für Projekt- und Leadership-Meetings vor.
* Du übernimmst organisatorische und koordinative Aufgaben rund um Meetings, Workshops und Projektveranstaltungen – von der Vorbereitung über die Dokumentation bis zur Nachbereitung.
* Du unterstützt eine effektive Projektadministration und ein strukturiertes Dokumentenmanagement, indem du Projektdokumentationen pflegst, offene Maßnahmen nachverfolgst und relevante Informationen strukturiert und aktuell hältst.
* Du setzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT für wiederkehrende Aufgaben ein, zum Beispiel für Meeting-Dokumentationen, Reporting, Informationskonsolidierung und die Erstellung von Unterlagen.
* Du wirkst an Prozessverbesserungs- und Automatisierungsinitiativen mit und hilfst dabei, effizientere Arbeitsweisen mithilfe von KI sowie Tools wie Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint und Excel zu identifizieren, zu testen und umzusetzen.

**Hiermit Begeisterst Du**

* Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang eingeschrieben – unabhängig von deiner Fachrichtung.
* Du hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder andere relevante Tätigkeiten gesammelt.
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
* Du bringst sehr gute organisatorische und administrative Fähigkeiten mit und hast Freude daran, Aufgaben zu koordinieren, Fristen im Blick zu behalten und strukturiert zu arbeiten.
* Du gehst sicher mit MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel, um und hast großes Interesse an KI und Automatisierung – idealerweise hast du bereits praktische Erfahrung mit Tools wie ChatGPT gesammelt.
* Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und sorgfältig und fühlst dich in der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern in einem internationalen Umfeld wohl.

Du willst dich gleich bei uns bewerben? Dann schick deine Unterlagen über den „Apply now“-Button zu uns. Bitte beachte, dass wir aus Datenschutzgründen keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail annehmen können. Alle wichtigen Informationen rund um deine Bewerbung findest du in unseren FAQs .
  
  
Du willst mehr über uns und unsere Unternehmenskultur erfahren? Hier geht's zu unserem Recruiting Video. .
  
  
**Über Simon-Kucher**
Simon-Kucher ist eine globale Unternehmensberatung mit mehr als 2.200 Mitarbeitenden in über 30 Ländern. Unser Fokus liegt darauf, nachhaltiges und profitables Wachstum zu erschließen und für unsere Kunden messbare Umsatz- und Ergebnissteigerungen zu realisieren. Als verlässlicher Partner für Commercial Excellence verbinden wir tiefgehende Beratungsexpertise mit Spezialisierung auf Wachstumsstrategien und technologischer Expertise, um nachhaltige Wertsteigerung zu ermöglichen. Wir optimieren sämtliche Hebel der kommerziellen Strategie – von Produkt, Pricing und Innovation bis hin zu Marketing, Vertrieb und digitalen Geschäftsmodellen – auf Basis fundierter Erkenntnisse zu Kundennutzen und Zahlungsbereitschaft. Mit über 40 Jahren Erfahrung in der Monetarisierung gelten wir als weltweit führende Beratung für Commercial Growth und Pricing. simon-kucher.com
  
  
Wir setzen uns für eine Unternehmenskultur ein, die Diversität, Gleichstellung und Inklusion fördert – und damit ein Umfeld der Anerkennung, das individuelle Entfaltung stärkt und den Beitrag eines jeden Einzelnen würdigt. So können wir weitreichende und positive Veränderungen bewirken. Wertschätzung und Anerkennung befähigen uns dazu, schneller zu wachsen, innovativer zu arbeiten und nachhaltigere Ergebnisse für alle zu erzielen – für unsere Teams, unsere Kunden und unser Unternehmen.

title: Corporate Human Resources Partner Working Student (12 Months) - 2027
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

See your impact in motion | Discover careers at our Data Centers
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Data Centers power the technology
  
people rely on every day, from streaming services and mobile apps to
  
cloud computing, generative AI, and online shopping. They’re the
  
foundation that enables hospitals, financial institutions, governments,
  
and businesses around the world to deliver the services people depend
  
on, when they need them.  
  
In these roles, you’ll work on the real-world infrastructure that keeps
  
technology running securely, reliably, and at global scale. You’ll solve
  
problems, collaborate across teams, and use advanced tools to support
  
systems that millions of people interact with every day.  
  
This is where your work connects to something bigger, moving beyond
  
theory into impact you can see, feel, and be part of, all while helping
  
build the future of Amazon Web Services.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Manage an end-to-end project with one of Amazon's HR teams in EMEA over a 12-week period

  

* Collaborate with senior management and business partners, as well as cross-functional HR support teams, to gain a 360-degree view of Amazon's approach to human resources

  

* Learn and contribute to Amazon's approach to hiring and developing top talent

  

* Support people operations and help preserve Amazon's peculiar culture in the way we attract, hire, and develop talented people

  

* Work cross-functionally across areas such as compensation, onboarding, training and development, talent acquisition, and international HR

  

* Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement creative solutions across HR teams worldwide

  

* Deliver a continuously improving employee experience by thinking broadly and working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment

  

* Gain insight into managerial strategy and concepts, understanding everything that goes on behind the scenes to ensure teams have what they need to develop and retain a high-powered workforce

  
A day in the life  
No two days are the same as a Working Student at Amazon. Depending on your team, you could be diving into your project work — whether that involves analyzing compensation data, supporting an onboarding improvement initiative, or collaborating with the talent acquisition team on hiring strategies. You will participate in cross-functional meetings with HR colleagues, including international HR teams, working through process improvements that impact teams worldwide. You will also have the opportunity to network with other interns and attend learning sessions with senior HR leaders who share insights on Amazon's peculiar culture and leadership principles.
  
  
Throughout, you will balance project-focused deep dives with broad exposure to HR operations, from training and development programs to employee experience initiatives. Every day brings hands-on experience in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your contributions directly support Amazon's ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent.
  
  
Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in German and English at C1 level or above
* Currently in your penultimate year and working towards a university bachelor’s or master’s in HR, HR Management, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Psychology, Social Sciences, Law or a related field (Humanities focused), or a similar discipline
* Eligible to complete a working student placement for up to 12 months

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
* Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
* Effective interpersonal, written, and oral communication with a keen focus on delivering business results.
* Demonstrated track record in using data and metrics to make decisions and build scalable solutions.
* Ability to influence across all levels of an organization.
* Ability to act strategically and make decisions under ambiguity.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.

title: Internship – Operations – DefenceTech (d/f/m)
description:
#### **New Challenge**

**About Us**

Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenceTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defence and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.

**About the Team**

Q`s Operations Team turns company’s strategy into reality: shipped hardware, working sites, processes and systems that hold up under pressure. We own the critical stuff in the background so engineering can engineer, sales can sell, and leadership can lead – without anyone getting stuck on a broken process, a missing part, or a spreadsheet held together by hope.

If something moves, gets ordered, built, tracked, or logged into a system – Operations is usually the reason it works.

**Your Role**

As Intern Operations, you join our team with real responsibility from week one. You will work closely with our COO and Operations team, as well as with a wide range internal and external stakeholders. You will help us to shape processes that will scale with the company!

**What you'll do**

* **Procurement and supplier coordination:** Request and compare quotes, track lead times, and follow up with suppliers and vendors on orders and deliveries.
* **Logistics and supply chain:** Coordinate shipments with logistics providers and customs, and keep order tracking and inventory accurate.
* **Site operations:** Support the day-to-day operations as well as events at Berlin sites in Mitte and Tegel.
* **Finance and compliance interfaces:** Prepare purchase orders, reconcile invoices with Finance, and support Legal/Compliance on export control documentation and security procedures.
* **Process improvement:** Spot bottlenecks in our operational workflows and turn messy, ambiguous tasks into clear, repeatable processes.
* **Documentation and workflows:** Keep documents, inventory records, and our internal tools (e.g. Confluence, Jira, ERP) up to date.

**You should apply if you**

* Have ongoing or completed study in supply chain management, business administration, industrial engineering or another technical field.
* Are available to work full-time for at least 3 months, ideally 6, starting from December 2026.
* Take ownership: you drive tasks to completion without being chased and flag problems early.
* Think in structures and bring order to ambiguous work, with a sharp eye for detail.
* Adapt easily to shifting priorities in a startup environment.
* Handle sensitive information with discretion and integrity.
* Are interested working in the defence sector and genuinely motivated to contribute to European safety.
* Speak German at least at C1 level, and English at least at B2 level.

**You'd be a great fit with**

* Prior internship or part-time work in operations, procurement, logistics, supply chain, or project management.
* Experience in a startup, scale-up, or hardware/manufacturing environment.
* Solid Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables and lookups.
* Familiarity with ERP, inventory, or project tools such as Confluence, and Jira.
* Interest in staying with us longer, for example as a working student after your internship or a permanent employee.

**We offer**

* The chance to be a part of our growth story and work on technology that strengthens European security and defence capability.
* A varied role with real responsibility, based in Berlin-Mitte and Berlin-Tegel.
* Flat hierarchies and a pleasant working environment.
* Opportunities for professional and personal development.
* 2.5 days of paid vacation per month of your internship (equivalent to 30 days per year).

#### **About us**

Q is a European defence-tech company pioneering the Internet of Defence with modular, scalable and interoperable sensor and intelligence solutions.

Location:
Berlin, BE, DE, 10405

Contact Person: Ivana Bandalo

Contact Information: jobs@ottobock.de

Job ID: 8714

**Summary Statement**
---------------------

At Ottobock, we are driving the digital transformation of the healthcare sector—and you can be part of it. Within our global User Experience team, you will work at the intersection of brand, community, and digital experiences.

  

Together with experienced marketing experts, external partners, ambassadors, and our community, you will create content that truly makes an impact. You can expect diverse tasks, plenty of creative freedom, and valuable insights into an innovative industry—along with an inspiring work environment at our Bötzow Campus in Berlin.

  

**Join our UX team and help shape the digital future of the med-tech industry.**

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* You support the development and execution of creative social media campaigns
* From the initial idea to final execution, you plan and organize video and photo shoots
* You independently create engaging social media content and develop creative assets
* Researching suitable influencers and creators, as well as maintaining our networks, is part of your responsibilities
* You are part of our community management team and engage directly with our target audience

**Qualifications**
------------------

* You are currently studying Business Administration, Communications, Marketing/Media, or a comparable degree program with a focus on marketing
* Social media is your world – you closely follow trends, creators, and digital communities
* A strong understanding of how content works on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn & Co. and what engages audiences sets you apart
* Ideally, you have already gained initial hands-on experience in social media, content creation, or community management
* You use tools such as Canva, CapCut, or Hootsuite confidently and creatively and can independently bring ideas to life
* A structured way of working, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously are among your strengths
* You bring initiative and a proactive mindset to drive topics forward
* Working with PowerPoint and Excel comes naturally to you
* Very good English skills complete your profile
* You enjoy teamwork and thrive in an international working environment

**Benefits**
------------

* The hourly wage is €17 and you will have 24 days of vacation
* Flexible working hours – ideal for combining work with your studies (maximum of 20 hours per week during the semester and up to 40 hours per week during semester breaks)
* Discounts & Benefits: Corporate Benefits and offers from local partners
* Onboarding & Development: Individual onboarding during the Ottobock Welcome Days as well as a wide range of training and development opportunities
* Growing student community & networking opportunities within the company
* Ownership & Teamwork: Independent responsibilities and direct integration into the team

**Diversity at Ottobock**
-------------------------

We believe in mutual respect, enjoyment at work, and a culture where everyone feels valued. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and welcome all applications - regardless of gender, age, nationality, disability, ethnic or social background, religion, or sexual orientation. We give special consideration to individuals with severe disabilities when equally qualified.

**Your future at Ottobock**
---------------------------

Ottobock’s products and services combine over 100 years of tradition with outstanding innovation in the fields of prosthetics, neuro-orthotics, and exoskeletons. Ottobock develops innovative fitting solutions for people with limited mobility and is driving the digitalisation of the industry. Founded in Berlin in 1919, the company has business activities in 45 countries with nearly 9,300 employees worldwide and operates the largest international patient care network with around 400 patient care clinics. Ottobock’s mission of improving freedom of movement, quality of life and independence is deeply rooted in the company's DNA, as is its social commitment: Ottobock has been a partner and supporter of the Paralympics since 1988.

**Apply now!** Your ideas and commitment will inspire your colleagues and staff, and will further the interests of Ottobock. Be part of a dynamic, growing company with flat hierarchies. We offer a richly diverse field of work, individual development opportunities and extensive qualification programs in our Ottobock Academy.

Please only apply via our online job portal at jobs.ottobock.com. Please quote the Job-ID for the position in question, and also state your earliest starting date and salary requirements. We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Performance Marketing Working Student (m/f/d)
description:
### **About Yepoda**

**Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.**

Our mission is to bring **Clean K-Beauty Innovations**,from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based **in the heart of Berlin**. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified **B Corp**, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

We are looking for **Working Students** to join our **Performance Marketing** team and get real, hands-on experience running paid campaigns across channels like Google, Meta, TikTok, and Youtube. You will support the team in setting up, monitoring, and optimising campaigns, work with live data and budgets from day one, and build practical skills in one of the most in-demand areas of e-commerce marketing.

### **Your tasks**

* **Campaign Support:** Assist in the setup, monitoring, and optimisation of marketing campaigns across our paid channels (Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok)
* **KPI Analysis & Reporting:** Support the ongoing analysis of campaign KPIs, prepare regular performance reports, and help the team adjust budgets for optimal performance
* **Creative Testing:** Collaborate with our Graphic Design team to test and refine ad creatives, formats, and messaging, and keep track of which variations perform best
* **Ideas & Concepts:** Contribute creative ideas and new concepts to improve campaign effectiveness, from fresh ad angles to social media trends worth testing

### **Your profile**

* You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Marketing, Media Management, Business, Economics, or a related field
* You have a strong interest in performance or online marketing, whether that shows up through your coursework, a previous internship or working student role, or your own projects
* You have strong analytical skills, great attention to detail, and enjoy turning campaign data into insights
* You communicate clearly and in a structured way, and bring a hands-on attitude and a high level of initiative
* You have a passion for beauty topics and a keen interest in social media trends (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)
* You are confident with Excel or Google Sheets; first experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, or TikTok Ads Manager is a bonus, and we're happy to bring the right person up to speed

### **What We Offer**

* **Dynamic Environment:** The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.
* **Accelerate Your Career:** Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.
* **Inspiring Workspace**: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.
* **Hybrid Working:** We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.
* **We Value Diversity:** We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.
* **Employee Discounts:** You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!
* **Unique Add Ons:** A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

**Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you!**

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

*At Yepoda we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.*
